svg.title: WorkflowMAX Support Copilot - Target support workflow
svg.desc: A single-page English flowchart with a vertical main path, clarification at left, repair at right, and human handling before approval. Matching C and H circles are connectors on this same page. The source contains 26 process or decision nodes and 33 directed relationships. The prototype uses only a TEST outbox.
svg.text: Two model stages | Program checks | Explicit human approval before the final reply

svg.text: It does not approve a reply.
Reply received: restore the full context
and run understanding and triage again.
